description: Nirvana Design Studio is a Mumbai-based design firm founded in 2016 by Architect Prajakta Rajendra Kabara. We excel in diverse architectural and interior projects, including farmhouse bungalows, community housing, and retail spaces like stores, boutiques, offices, restaurants, and residences. Our philosophy treats architecture as an art form that enhances human experience. We meticulously select materials, plants, fabrics, lighting, textures, and furniture to create sensory-rich spaces that support and elevate human behavior. Emphasizing context-specific analysis and research, we value flexibility, authenticity, and adaptability. Our mission is to design blissful, tranquil, productive, and creative spaces, making the ordinary extraordinary.
